english.title: Fail to satisfy the Commissioners regarding goods reaching destination not in declaration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person concerned in the exportation of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), subject to a

(A)_[prohibition]_
(B)_[restriction]_

to which section 77(3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY PROHIBITION OR RESTRICTION..), failed, when required by the Commissioners, to satisfy them that those goods had not reached a destination other than that mentioned, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE MENTIONED..) in the declaration made in respect of the goods
english.legislation: Contrary to section 77(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence for the defendant to prove that he did not consent to or connive at the goods reaching any destination other than that mentioned in the entry delivered in respect of the goods; and that he took all reasonable steps to secure that the ultimate destination of the goods was not other than that so mentioned.
(ii) For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020 see offence wording document H10723 (CJS code CE79299).
